svg.title: L4 Detail -- DFE on AWS, egress
svg.desc: S3 traffic from the nodes leaves through a gateway endpoint and never crosses the NAT gateway. Everything else bound for the internet, such as image pulls the registry cache does not serve and a managed Kafka outside AWS, leaves through the NAT gateway in the public subnets.
